name: fin-vscode
description: Fin language support for Visual Studio Code

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Fin support does not run the compiler, formatter or linter in an untrusted workspace. Highlighting, hover, completion and outline read text only and keep working.

commands.title: Restart toolchain (reload compiler, formatter and stdlib)

fin.compilerPath.markdownDescription: Path to the `finc` compiler, or just its name to search `PATH`. Relative paths resolve against the first workspace folder.

fin.formatterPath.markdownDescription: Path to the `finfmt` formatter, or just its name to search `PATH`. Relative paths resolve against the first workspace folder.

fin.includePaths.markdownDescription: Extra module search directories passed to `finc` as `-I <path>`. Relative paths resolve against the first workspace folder.

fin.stdlibPath.markdownDescription: Directory holding the Fin standard library (`*.fin`). Empty means derive it from the compiler location as `<compiler>/../lib/std`, which is where a normal Fin install keeps it.

fin.diagnostics.enabled.markdownDescription: Run `finc --diagnostics=json` on change and show its problems as diagnostics. Turning this off clears the problems Fin reported.

fin.format.onSave.markdownDescription: Format with `finfmt` when a `.fin` file is saved. `editor.formatOnSave` also works, through the registered formatting provider.

fin.lint.linfEnabled.markdownDescription: Also run the optional [`linf`](https://github.com/M1778/linf) style linter and merge its `linf:*` warnings into the diagnostic stream. Compiler diagnostics are always the primary stream.

fin.lint.linfPath.markdownDescription: Path to the `linf` binary used when `fin.lint.linfEnabled` is on.

fin.trace.markdownDescription: How much of Fin's own work reaches the **Fin** output channel: `off`, `messages` (each compiler invocation and its summary), or `verbose` (also the raw JSONL and stderr).

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:grammar
scripts.test:unit: node --test test/diagnostics.test.js test/exec.test.js test/stdlib-model.test.js test/stdlib-real.test.js test/config.test.js
